comment: kiln.render's camera on the client (docs/re/client-render.md, 'The camera'). The client fills the local player's ClientPlayerInput.camera (keen::ecs::ClientCamera: WorldPosition 3 x int64 32.32, quaternion x y z w, distance, fovY, aspect, near, far) from its 3C camera object once per client frame on the main thread. kiln.render reads it right after the write, a few instructions past kiln.rules' read-only camera check (rules/client.CameraInput), so both hooks coexist. The field offsets are captured from the stores and fixed, so a build with another layout refuses the feature. Found on client 26430625 (5d9ef2f1...).

render/client.CameraWritten.comment: rbp = the client game (camera object at [rbp + cam.obj], null when there is none: then the stores are skipped), r14 = the local player's ClientPlayerInput (camera at +cpi.camera); the mid hook goes on 'lea r8, [rbp + ...]' after the call that follows the camera block, reached by both branches
